shots.x: The kings arrive in a column that does not end: escort after escort, banner after banner, filling the streets of Kuṇḍina.
In the hall they swear it together and then one by one: if he comes for her, we fight him.
Rukmini at a window above them, counting banners. There are too many to count.
On the road outside, Balarama arrives with an army behind him and says what he has come for.
shots.dlg: Balarama: You came for a bride. I came for the war that follows her.
shots.te: నువ్వు పెళ్లికూతురి కోసం వచ్చావు. ఆమె వెనకాల వచ్చే యుద్ధం కోసం నేను వచ్చాను.
